item.tib: tshe dbang gsang bsgrub yid bzhin nor bu
item.coloph: de ltar rig 'dzin thugs kyi gsang bsgrubs (sgrub) zhes bya ba/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin dgongs pa'i bcud bsdus te/phyi rab (rabs) skal ldan blo chung don nyid du/ go sla khyer bde man ngag gdams pa ste/ lta ba yang rtse bsgom pa'i man ngag don/ spyod pa mthar thug 'bras bu re dogs bral/ sku gsum lhun grub bdag med dgongs pa rtogs/ sangs rgyas lags (lag) 'chang khyad par zab lam bon/ shin tu zab pa'i cig (gcig) rgyud sA mA yA/ rgya rgya rgya/ ces gsungs nas b+he ro tsa na dang / stang chen dmu tsa gyer med dang 'od ldan 'bar ma gsum la bstan ste (te) bstan pa'i gnyer du gtad do/ de ltar gsang bsgrub (sgrub) yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ yum chen mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bcud phyung nas/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag la snyan du brgyud(rgyud)/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par bya (byas/)dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyongs srung pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i phyag rgya chen po'i sa thob shog/
